lithium intercalated in manganese oxides reduces the oxygen ion but not the manganese ion.
the electronic structure of the MnO2 lattice expands upon the addition of lithium, and this causes an increase in the 2p character of the oxygen and a decrease in the 3d character of the Mn.
the electronic structure of lithium manganese oxide for rechargeable battery electrodes is strongly modified by lithium intercalation.

the electronic structures of manganese oxide electrodes, in particular, with the effects of chemical and structural changes caused by lithium intercalation on the electronic structures.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electronic state of lithium manganese oxide changes to a state similar to that of MnO 2 as the amount of intercalated lithium increases.

the electronic structures of lithium manganese oxide electrodes are not so simple as to be characterized by the ionicity.
